title: Targeted inhibition of colorectal carcinoma using a designed CEA-binding protein to deliver TCF/LEF transcription factor decoy DNA and p53 protein
authors: Wen Wang; Xuan Sun; Geng Wu
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用设计的CEA结合蛋白递送TCF/LEF转录因子诱饵DNA和p53蛋白靶向抑制结直肠癌，虽涉及TF-DNA结合基序，但核心是药物递送与肿瘤治疗，缺乏AI或物理模拟的互作建模方法。
abstract: Colorectal carcinoma (CRC) is characterized by mutations in Wnt signaling pathway components and the p53 protein, and anti□PD-1/anti□PD-L1 immunotherapy has shown limited efficacy in microsatellite stable CRC patients. In this work, CEABP1, a de novo-designed binding protein for the CRC marker carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA), and cell-penetrating peptide (CPP) were employed for targeted delivery in CRC cells. The consensus binding motifs for TCF/LEF and Max were concatenated, and Max DNA binding domain protein fused with CPP and CEABP1 was used to deliver this TCF/LEF transcription factor decoy (TFD) DNA specifically into CRC cells by recognizing CEA on the CRC cell surface to inhibit Wnt target gene transcription, leading to marked suppression of CRC cell proliferation and xenograft tumor growth. In addition, p28 was employed as a CPP to specifically deliver the p28-p53-CEABP1 protein into CRC cells, which significantly enhanced p53 inhibition of CRC cell proliferation and xenograft tumor growth. Furthermore, codelivery of the p14 ARF protein together with p53 increased its antitumor activity by prolonging its effective duration. These findings paved the way for the development of related biomacromolecular anticancer therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）的特征在于Wnt信号通路组分和p53蛋白的突变，而抗PD-1/抗PD-L1免疫治疗在微卫星稳定型CRC患者中显示出有限的疗效。在本工作中，CEABP1（一种针对CRC标志物癌胚抗原（CEA）的全新设计结合蛋白）和细胞穿透肽（CPP）被用于CRC细胞的靶向递送。将TCF/LEF和Max的共有结合基序串联，并使用与CPP和CEABP1融合的Max DNA结合域蛋白，通过识别CRC细胞表面的CEA，将这种TCF/LEF转录因子诱饵（TFD）DNA特异性地递送到CRC细胞中，以抑制Wnt靶基因的转录，从而显著抑制CRC细胞增殖和异种移植肿瘤生长。此外，采用p28作为CPP，将p28-p53-CEABP1蛋白特异性地递送到CRC细胞中，显著增强了p53对CRC细胞增殖和异种移植肿瘤生长的抑制作用。进一步地，将p14 ARF蛋白与p53共递送，通过延长其有效持续时间，增强了其抗肿瘤活性。这些发现为相关生物大分子抗癌疗法的开发铺平了道路。
